name: Madison Children's Museum Volunteers
what_you_do: You help kids play and learn at the museum. You can help with Rooftop Ramble animals and gardens. You can help in Art Studio or be a Play Ambassador. You can help in the outdoor Wonderground from April to October.
who_can_apply: Ages 14 and up can volunteer on their own. Ages 8 to 13 can volunteer with a caregiver.
duration: One 2-hour shift each week for at least two months
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Shifts are filled first come, first served.
how_to_apply: Fill out the volunteer application form on the page, clear a background check, interview (in person, Zoom or phone), attend orientation, then sign up for shifts on Sign Up Genius.
notes: Volunteer Coordinator: Tim Gruber, tgruber@madisonchildrensmuseum.org. Spots may be limited at any given time, so email before you apply.
